title: Fed&\#x27;s Goolsbee calls October inflation report &\#x27;borderline disturbing&\#x27; as officials weigh more hikes
summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee called October&\#x27;s inflation report "borderline disturbing" after the consumer price index rose 0.4% on a seasonally adjusted basis, the third straight month of larger-than-expected increases. Fed funds futures now fully expect a rate hike at the December meeting, with 15% odds it comes as a half-point increase, according to CME&\#x27;s FedWatch tool.
